description: Query InterPro for the taxonomic breadth of Pfam PF07818 and build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts
code:
import requests, json, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("provenance", exist_ok=True)
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

# ---------- 1. How broadly is the PF07818 / IPR012479 family conserved? ----------
# InterPro taxonomy endpoint, counted at the level of its stored taxon nodes.
tax={}
for name,taxid in [("Eukaryota",2759),("Fungi",4751),("Metazoa",33208),
                   ("Viridiplantae",33090),("Saccharomycetes",4891),
                   ("Schizosaccharomyces",4895),("Bacteria",2),("Archaea",2157)]:
    u=f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/protein/UniProt/entry/pfam/PF07818/taxonomy/uniprot/{taxid}/"
    try:
        r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=60)
        n=r.json().get("count") if r.status_code==200 else 0
        tax[name]=n if n else 0
    except Exception as e:
        tax[name]=None
    print(f"PF07818 proteins under {name:18s} (taxid {taxid:6d}): {tax[name]}")

# ---------- 2. Evidence matrix ----------
EM=[
 ("PMID:42034640","structural / direct assay","supports",
  "The SAP30BP fold has a defined molecular function: scaffolding a CDK11-cyclin L kinase complex",
  "Cryo-EM at 2.3 A shows SAP30BP forms extensive interactions with cyclin L2, stabilising it, and critical interactions with the C-terminal kinase lobe of CDK11; the complex phosphorylates SF3B1 during spliceosome B to Bact activation",
  "Human proteins, cryo-EM plus biochemistry","High for human. Gives the function that the fold implies. No fission yeast work in the paper."),
 ("PDB:9QKZ / 9QKT / 9QL1","structural / computational","supports",
  "mug151 is structurally homologous to experimental SAP30BP",
  "Reciprocal Foldseek from 9QKZ chain A retrieves mug151 at E=9.05e-04, probability 1.0, 25.8 percent identity over 120 residues; Kabsch fit of mug151 31-131 onto chain A gives 3.82 A over 98 CA pairs, 2.01 A over 56, TM-score 0.494 (norm 118) and 0.541 (norm 101)",
  "AlphaFold model AF-Q10069-F1-v6 vs cryo-EM chain","High for fold identity. TM-score straddles the 0.5 threshold, so the margin is modest."),
 ("Foldseek run (this report)","computational","supports",
  "mug151 has a confident structural homolog and only one",
  "Full model vs AFDB50/AFDB-SwissProt/AFDB-proteome returned 964 hits, 0 against PDB100; best SwissProt hit is human SAP30BP Q9UHR5 at E=7.77e-06, probability 1.0, 24.4 percent identity, 139 aligned residues, 94 percent query coverage; 73 percent of 936 AFDB50 hits are named SAP30BP or HCNGP; the next-best unrelated family (TTC14) sits at E=1 to 5.5, probability 0.12 to 0.54",
  "AlphaFold DB and PDB100 searches","High. The 0 PDB100 hits are a snapshot-currency artifact, confirmed because the experimental SAP30BP chain itself also returns 0 PDB100 hits."),
 ("InterPro IPR012479 / Pfam PF07818","review / database","qualifies",
  "mug151 belongs to the SAP30BP/HCNGP family",
  "PF07818 covers mug151 34-127 at E=4e-27; mug151 is the only S. pombe member of PANTHER PTHR13464, so no paralog confusion; S. cerevisiae has zero PF07818 members; only three SwissProt-reviewed members exist (Q9UHR5 human, Q02614 mouse, Q10069 mug151)",
  "Sequence database","High for membership. The family label 'transcriptional regulator HCNGP' is legacy naming predating the 2023-2026 splicing work."),
 ("PMID:38065098","direct assay / interaction","qualifies",
  "The human SAP30BP cofactor function transfers to mug151",
  "A UHM in RBM17 binds a UHM-ligand motif in SAP30BP (KRKSKW 252-257), recruiting RBM17 to phosphorylated SF3B1; mug151 has no ULM, no tryptophan anywhere in a ULM context, and S. pombe has no RBM17/SPF45 member of PTHR48034 or IPR050441",
  "Human in vitro binding and NMR","High for human. The motif and the receptor are both absent in S. pombe, so this specific activity does not transfer."),
 ("PMID:22681890","mutant phenotype / genetic interaction","supports (weakly)",
  "mug151 acts near the splicing machinery in S. pombe",
  "BioGRID records a negative genetic interaction between mug151 and prp22, the spliceosomal DEAH-box ATPase, plus negative with rsv2 and positive with par1 and wdr7",
  "S. pombe genome-wide genetic interaction screen","Low to moderate. Genetic interactions are indirect and this is screen-scale data."),
 ("PMID:24957674","mutant phenotype / genetic interaction","supports (weakly)",
  "mug151 acts near the splicing machinery in S. pombe",
  "Negative genetic interaction between mug151 and xap5, annotated as a XAP5-like splicing factor",
  "S. pombe screen","Low to moderate. Indirect."),
 ("STRING v12 (database)","review / database","competing",
  "S. pombe network data independently support a mug151-cdk11-lcp1 association",
  "Edges mug151-cdk11 0.696 and mug151-lcp1 0.611 sit entirely in the experiments channel with database 0.000 and text 0.000; the PSICQUIC BioGRID record for Q10069 holds exactly 5 interactions, all MI:0254 genetic interference, none physical and none with cdk11 or lcp1",
  "S. pombe network database","The edges are most consistent with interolog transfer from the human complex. They are not independent fission yeast evidence."),
 ("UniProt / PomBase (database)","review / database","supports",
  "The partners implied by the fold exist in S. pombe",
  "cdk11 = O60145 (ppk23, SPBC18H10.15, 398 aa) carries InterPro IPR045267 CDK11/PITSLRE_STKc and PANTHER PTHR24056:SF107; lcp1 = O94612 (SPAC1296.05c, 258 aa) is a cyclin L; STRING links cdk11-lcp1 at 0.94",
  "S. pombe proteome","High for presence. Says nothing about whether mug151 joins them."),
 ("Interface mapping (this report)","computational","qualifies",
  "Interface residues are preferentially conserved, which would corroborate the transferred function",
  "74 SAP30BP residues lie within 4.5 A of CDK11B or cyclin L2 in 9QKZ; 70 map onto mug151; identity is 23/70 (32.9 percent) at the interface vs 8/40 (20.0 percent) elsewhere; Fisher one-sided OR 1.96, p = 0.110",
  "Structure-guided alignment","The enrichment is in the expected direction but not significant at n=110. The FRNP motif (human F159-R160-N161-P162 to mug151 F73-R74-N75-P76) is conserved; CDK11-contacting K157, S163, E166, K167 and W191 are not."),
 ("QuickGO (database)","review / database","qualifies",
  "The current GO annotation set for mug151 reflects current knowledge",
  "mug151 carries ND roots on all three aspects (GO:0003674, GO:0008150, GO:0005575), one IEA BP (GO:0006355 regulation of DNA-templated transcription, from IPR012479) and one IEA CC (GO:0005634 nucleus, UniProtKB-SubCell)",
  "GO database","The GO:0006355 IEA rests on the legacy 'HCNGP transcriptional regulator' family label, which the 2023-2026 structural work has displaced."),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(EM,columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested",
                            "key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
em.to_csv("provenance/mug151_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("\nEvidence matrix rows:",len(em))
print(em[["citation","evidence_type","stance"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 3. GO decision table ----------
GO=[
 ("GO:0006355","BP","regulation of DNA-templated transcription","present, IEA from InterPro IPR012479",
  "remove or flag as legacy","The IEA derives from the family name 'transcriptional regulator HCNGP'. PMID:42034640 and PMID:38065098 reassign the human family to spliceosome activation. No S. pombe transcription evidence for mug151 exists."),
 ("GO:0005634","CC","nucleus","present, IEA from UniProtKB-SubCell",
  "retain","Consistent with the human protein and with a splicing-associated role. No direct S. pombe localisation data were found."),
 ("GO:0003674","MF","molecular_function (ND root)","present, ND",
  "candidate replacement","The fold assignment now gives a positive MF lead, so the ND root is no longer the best available statement."),
 ("GO:0016538","MF","cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity","absent",
  "candidate new term, ISS-style, curator verification required","This is the function the fold implies via PMID:42034640. Supported by fold identity plus presence of cdk11 (O60145) and lcp1 (O94612) in S. pombe. Blocked from direct assertion by the lack of any S. pombe physical interaction or activity assay."),
 ("GO:0000381 / GO:0048024","BP","regulation of alternative mRNA splicing / regulation of mRNA splicing via spliceosome","absent",
  "candidate new term, weak lead","Supported by the human complex phosphorylating SF3B1 plus two negative genetic interactions in S. pombe with the splicing factors prp22 and xap5. Too indirect to assert without a direct experiment."),
 ("GO:0008150","BP","biological_process (ND root)","present, ND",
  "retain for now","The splicing lead is suggestive but no S. pombe process evidence meets IDA, IMP or IGI standards for a specific term."),
 ("GO:0005575","CC","cellular_component (ND root)","present, ND",
  "remove as redundant","GO:0005634 is already asserted, so the ND root on the same aspect carries no information."),
 ("GO:0005515","MF","protein binding","absent",
  "do not use","GO:0016538 is more informative and is supported by the same evidence."),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=["go_id","aspect","term","current_status",
                            "recommended_action","rationale"])
go.to_csv("provenance/mug151_go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\nGO decision table:")
print(go[["go_id","aspect","current_status","recommended_action"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 4. Figure: family breadth (computed above) + stance tally (from the matrix) ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
ks=[k for k in tax if tax[k] is not None]
vs=[tax[k] for k in ks]
ax.bar(range(len(ks)),[max(v,0.5) for v in vs],color='#4c72b0',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
ax.set_yscale('log'); ax.set_xticks(range(len(ks)))
ax.set_xticklabels(ks,rotation=35,ha='right',fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(vs): ax.text(i,max(v,0.5),str(v),ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("UniProt proteins with PF07818 (log)")
ax.set_title("A. PF07818 (SAP30BP/HCNGP) taxonomic breadth, InterPro API",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
order=["supports","supports (weakly)","qualifies","competing"]
cnt=[int((em.stance==o).sum()) for o in order]
cols=['#55a868','#9ecf9a','#dd8452','#c44e52']
ax.barh(range(len(order)),cnt,color=cols,edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("evidence rows"); ax.set_xlim(0,6)
for i,c in enumerate(cnt): ax.text(c+0.08,i,str(c),va='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("B. Evidence matrix stance tally (11 rows)\n"
             "0 rows refute the fold assignment; the qualifiers limit\n"
             "how far the implied function transfers",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

json.dump(tax,open("provenance/PF07818_taxonomy_counts.json","w"),indent=1)
print("\nsaved provenance/mug151_evidence_matrix.csv, mug151_go_decision_table.csv, PF07818_taxonomy_counts.json")
